title: An agent's run report (abp/runs/<role>/<run>.json)
description: Written at the end of every run by node abp/tools.mjs run-report, from the ABP hook's log (~/.abp/log/) and the run's commits. It never carries what the owner typed: prompts and tool targets are recorded as their length and a hash keyed by a per-machine salt, unless the owner opts in (policy logging.include_text and the --include-text flag), and then only redacted. A run without its report is a breach (core rule R10). Kept by the abp agent.

run.description: the run's id: its start time, filesystem-safe

line.description: one sentence by the agent: what this run did

text_included.description: true only when the owner's policy logs text and the report was made with --include-text; false by default

requests.description: the prompts this run received, as length and keyed hash; never the text, except a redacted head when text_included is true

sha256.description: the first 16 hex digits of HMAC-SHA-256 under the machine's salt (~/.abp/salt, never committed): it matches a prompt to the local log without revealing it

head.description: only when text_included: the redacted start of the prompt

session_events.description: starts, resumes, clears and compactions, each re-anchored

compactions.description: the canary: compactions logged by PreCompact against SessionStart re-anchors with source compact; fewer re-anchors than compactions is a breach (the policy may have been lost)

policies_executed.description: core rule id -> how many times the hook decided by it this run

policies_instrumented.description: the core rules held by a hook (the rest are re-anchored rules or reviewed hourly)

mandate.description: what the agent did inside its grant

reach.description: what was possible but outside the grant: every call the hook would deny, blocked (breaker on or enforce mode) or observed (logged and allowed)

kind.description: what the call was, e.g. write, git-push, send, connector, tamper, write-unidentified

target_chars.description: the length of the command, path, URL or query

target_sha256.description: its keyed hash, as for requests

what.description: only when text_included: the redacted reason, which can name the target

target.description: only when text_included: the redacted target

breaches.description: an action outside the grant that happened (a commit outside its paths, a missed re-anchor, a hook that failed, closed for writes or open for reads)
